title: HyperFit · Material calibration
heading: Study stress and volume together.
intro: Combine material models, inspect residuals and select parameters using explicit error scales.
units: Volume: ln J · Stress and moduli: MPa
data.heading: Experimental data
data.hint: Processed by the current server. Confirm stress, strain and volume definitions, and select a single loading branch.
model.heading: Material model
param.name: Parameter
model.hint: Positive moduli use logarithmic search coordinates by default. Bounds constrain the search; they do not prove stability.
fit.heading: Fitting criterion
note.tolerance: Tolerances express acceptable deviations, not measurement standard deviations or confidence levels.
note.peak: Errors are divided by the observed channel peak. The same percentage error still contributes more at larger amplitudes.
note.uncertainty: Enter a known standard-deviation model for independent observations. Squared loss corresponds to weighted least squares for independent Gaussian observations; arbitrary tolerances are not known noise.
fit.initHint: Automatic mode samples within the bounds, using logarithmic coordinates for positive moduli. Coupled responses are screened before selecting multiple starts. The same seed, data, bounds and versions reproduce the run. Entered initial values are used only in manual mode.
fit.tradeoffHint: Compare 3 weights, using roughly 3 times the computation. Non-dominated candidates are from the explored set, not a global Pareto front.
status.complete: Fit complete. Check residuals, convergence and parameter sensitivity.
status.unqualified: No candidate both converged and passed the sampled stability screen. Results are diagnostic only.
status.cancelRequested: Cancellation requested; FE jobs respond after the current load increment.
status.interrupted: Job interrupted; restart using the saved configuration.
response.heading: Response comparison
response.synthetic: The synthetic example includes small artificial noise and is for demonstration only. Fitting uses a homogeneous uniaxial material point; FE verification is separate.
response.experimental: Fit assumptions: isotropy, homogeneous uniaxial deformation and traction-free lateral faces. Significant clamping or nonuniform deformation requires a matched FE observation region.
chart.tradeoff: Explored candidates: select to view curves
chart.tradeoffAxis: Stress RMSE / MPa (vertical: ln J RMSE)
residual.heading: Where errors occur
residual.hint: Residuals are divided by each channel's observed peak. Tolerances, interval weights and robust fitting losses do not hide these raw deviations.
candidate.heading: Parameter candidates
candidate.empty: After fitting, compare parameters, errors and sensitivity here. Similar curves do not imply unique parameters.
candidate.name: Candidate
fem.heading: Check the selected model with FEM
fem.hint: A freely contracting cube with three-field mixed elements checks the material-point response. It does not validate the original specimen geometry or replace full stability analysis.
fem.result: {cells} mixed elements; stretch {stretch}; Cauchy stress {stress} MPa; mean ln J = {volume}. Material-point comparison: max nominal-stress difference {stressError} MPa; max ln J difference {volumeError}.
footer: Local research tool · GPL-3.0-or-later · Not run-verified in Abaqus
import.heading: Confirm data definitions
import.hint: The first row must contain column names. Blank cells, duplicate or non-increasing strains cause an error; they are not removed automatically.
import.summary: {rows} rows, {columns} columns. Data are not automatically sorted or trimmed.
error.generic: The operation could not be completed. See technical details.
error.network: Cannot reach the local service. Check that it is running and try again.
error.validation: Invalid input. Check the fields and parameter ranges.
error.monotonic: Select a single loading branch with strictly increasing axial strain; no automatic sorting is applied.
error.bounds: Invalid parameter bounds. Lower bounds must be below upper bounds, and logarithmically sampled parameters need positive lower bounds.
error.initial: Manual initial values must lie within the selected bounds.
error.seed: The random seed must be an integer from 0 to 4294967295.
error.initialization: Check initialization mode, pool size and starts. If too few valid starts remain, enlarge the pool or revise the physical bounds.
error.pool: Only {valid} valid initial points for {starts} starts. Adjust the bounds or increase the pool.
error.budget: Use 1–10 starts and 5–500 evaluations per start.
error.physical: Material parameters violate physical or numerical conditions. Check positive moduli, initial shear modulus, β ≥ 0 and α intervals away from zero.
error.scales: Absolute scales and weights must be positive; relative scales and the low-strain threshold must be nonnegative. All values must be finite.
error.uncertainty: Known-standard-deviation mode requires independent-observation weighting without preference weights or tradeoff sweeps.
error.zeroPeak: A zero signal cannot be peak-normalized. Use an absolute tolerance.
error.noCandidate: No valid candidate found. Check the model, parameter bounds and data definitions.
error.forward: The material response failed to solve or failed a local stability check. Check parameters and strain range.
error.fileSize: The file exceeds the 10 MB local import limit.
error.rows: Worksheets are limited to 50000 rows; select 4–3000 points for interactive fitting.
error.fileType: Use CSV, TSV or XLSX. Convert legacy XLS files first.
error.header: The header is missing or has too many columns. Check the first row.
error.columns: Select three distinct, valid data columns.
error.cells: Selected columns contain blanks, text or non-finite values. Check the source data.
error.measures: Check stress, strain and volume measures and units.
error.notComplete: The job has not completed; results cannot be exported yet.
error.notFound: Job not found. Check the job ID or service status.
